title: Adding Metrics To Your Resume (even if you don't think you can)
description:
Metric-based achievements are the highest impact type of achievements, but what if your work doesn’t really revolve around numbers? A few things to think about are “What are the numbers your supervisor is concerned with?” “Did you make or save the company?” and the number of personnel you assisted/served/managed. #resumetips #resumebuilder #resumebullets
